content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement. Compensation is straightforward time-and-materials with rates set per SOW, and there is no obligation flowing from Clear Capital to RadialSpark to match or extend third-party terms.

input.quote: (a) During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work. Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation) sets rates by Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis, with the only pricing mechanic being Contractor's right to change rates on 30 days' notice. Searches for most-favoured-nation style language ("most favoured", "favorable", "no less", "pricing", "other customer", "terms offered") returned no hits anywhere in the Agreement, and no other section imposes a benchmarking or price-matching duty. There is therefore no obligation requiring Clear Capital to offer RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, which is the preferred position under this rule. Because this is a direction rule and the absent obligation would only have burdened us, no redline is warranted.
